queries: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_ratio DESC) AS event_rank FROM event_averages) SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 3;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(e.location), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY (average_ratio IS NULL), average_ratio DESC) AS event_rank FROM event_averages) SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: A zero budget amount makes the ratio undefined; AVG excludes that line. An event whose lines have no defined ratios has a NULL average and ranks last.
A location is unrecorded when event.location is NULL.

assumptions.assumption: A NULL, empty, or whitespace-only location is unrecorded.
Budget lines with a zero or NULL amount have an undefined ratio and are ignored by AVG; events with no defined ratios retain a NULL average.

alternatives.interpretation: An empty location is a recorded location; only NULL means unrecorded.
